infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: AForce OS uses your camera to scan hydration product barcodes.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: AForce OS uses your location to show local temperature and humidity, which drive your personalized hydration recommendations.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: AForce OS reads heart rate, HRV, sleep, and workout data from Apple Health to personalize your hydration and recovery score.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: AForce OS writes hydration logs to Apple Health so they appear alongside your other health data.
